originalTitle: 30-year Treasury yield tops 5.31%, the highest in 19 years
summary: Treasury yields were higher as traders awaited the latest FOMC minutes due later this week.
content:
Treasury yields were higher on Monday as oil prices rose, with worries growing among investors about persistent inflation and government borrowing.

The 30-year Treasury yield, which is typically sensitive to geopolitical events, advanced more than 4 basis points to 5.311%. It reached its highest level since June 2007.

The 10-year Treasury note yield — the main benchmark for mortgages, auto loans and credit card debt — was more than 2 basis points higher at 4.724%.

The yield on the 2-year Treasury note, which typically reacts in line with short-term Federal Reserve interest rate decisions, rose more than 1 basis point to 4.182%.

One basis point equals 0.01%, or 1/100th of 1%, and yields and prices move inversely to one another.

Oil prices rose as the 60-day deadline for the U.S. and Iran to secure a peace deal is expiring Monday, with Iran ruling out the possibility of an extension, according to state media. A senior Iranian official also told Reuters that Tehran would take an offensive stance if diplomacy with the U.S. fails.

West Texas Intermediate futures gained 2.6% to settle at $84.50 per barrel. Global benchmark Brent crude advanced 2.7% to close at $90.87 a barrel.

Elevated energy prices in the wake of the Middle East conflict breaking out months ago have raised concerns about inflationary pressures, though the latest batch of mild inflation data has offered some reassurance to investors.

Strategists at Barclays see the rise in rates less about inflation and more about the U.S. budget deficit, high levels of issuance related to artificial intelligence competing with Treasurys, and higher term premiums, or the extra yield investors are seeking to hold government debt.

"What is notable today is not the existence of these pressures, but that they appear strong enough to overwhelm individual soft-data releases," Anshul Pradhan, head of U.S. rates research at Barclays Capital, said in a note Monday. "Three independent releases argued for lower yields this month; long end yields moved higher anyway."

Bond yields rose during Friday's session after retail sales fell by a surprise 0.6% last month, which came after a flat producer price index report month-on-month in July.

Last week, the Treasury Department reported that the U.S. budget deficit reached its highest monthly level in more than five years , with rising Medicare costs and interest on the federal debt serving as contributors. The year-to-date total for the federal government's fiscal year has exceeded the amount seen during the same period last year.

"We believe investors are increasingly evaluating Treasury securities through the lens of longer-term fiscal sustainability and less through the lens of inflation, monetary policy, and growth, at least for the longer end of the Treasury curve," wrote Anthony Saglimbene, Ameriprise chief market strategist, in a Monday note.

Investors are now awaiting July's Federal Open Market Committee meeting minutes, due Wednesday, for further insights into the Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy decisions and potential future rates trajectory.

The Fed voted 9-3 to hold rates steady at between 3.5% and 3.75% for the fifth consecutive meeting on July 29. The three dissenting committee members — Beth Hammack of Cleveland, Neel Kashkari of Minneapolis and Lorie Logan of Dallas — instead called for a 25 basis point hike.
chineseTitle: 30年期国债收益率突破5.31%，创19年来最高
chineseSummary: 由于交易员等待本周晚些时候公布的最新联邦公开市场委员会会议纪要，美国国债收益率走高。
chineseContent:
随着油价上涨，投资者对持续通胀和政府借贷的担忧加剧，周一美国国债收益率走高。

通常对地缘政治事件敏感的30年期国债收益率上涨逾4个基点至5.311%。达到2007年6月以来的最高水平。

10 年期国债收益率（抵押贷款、汽车贷款和信用卡债务的主要基准）上涨超过 2 个基点，达到 4.724%。

两年期国债收益率通常与美联储短期利率决定一致，上涨超过 1 个基点至 4.182%。

一个基点等于 0.01%，即 1% 的 1/100，收益率和价格走势成反比。

据官方媒体报道，美国和伊朗达成和平协议的 60 天最后期限将于周一到期，而伊朗排除了延期的可能性，油价上涨。一名伊朗高级官员还告诉路透社，如果与美国的外交失败，德黑兰将采取进攻立场。

西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨 2.6%，收于每桶 84.50 美元。全球基准布伦特原油上涨 2.7%，收于每桶 90.87 美元。

几个月前中东冲突爆发后能源价格上涨引发了人们对通胀压力的担忧，尽管最新一批温和的通胀数据给投资者带来了一些安慰。

巴克莱的策略师认为，利率上升更多是因为美国预算赤字、与美国国债竞争的人工智能相关的高发行量、以及更高的期限溢价或投资者寻求持有政府债务的额外收益。

巴克莱资本(Barclays Capital)美国利率研究主管安舒尔·普拉丹(Anshul Pradhan)周一在一份报告中表示：“今天值得注意的不是这些压力的存在，而是它们似乎强大到足以压倒个别软数据发布。” “三份独立发布的报告主张本月收益率较低；无论如何，长期收益率都会走高。”

上个月零售销售意外下降 0.6%，而 7 月份生产者价格指数环比持平，导致周五交易时段债券收益率上涨。

上周，美国财政部报告称，美国预算赤字达到五年多来的最高月度水平，医疗保险成本上升和联邦债务利息增加是造成这一情况的原因。联邦政府财政年度迄今为止的总额已超过去年同期的数额。

Ameriprise 首席市场策略师 Anthony Saglimbene 在周一的一份报告中写道：“我们认为，投资者越来越多地从长期财政可持续性的角度来评估国债，而不是从通胀、货币政策和增长的角度来评估国债，至少在国债曲线的较长端是这样。”

投资者目前正在等待周三公布的 7 月份联邦公开市场委员会会议纪要，以进一步了解美联储最新的货币政策决定和未来潜在的利率轨迹。

美联储在 7 月 29 日连续第五次会议上以 9 比 3 的投票结果将利率稳定在 3.5% 至 3.75% 之间。三名持反对意见的委员会成员——克利夫兰的贝丝·哈马克 (Beth Hammack)、明尼阿波利斯的尼尔·卡什卡里 (Neel Kashkari) 和达拉斯的洛里·洛根 (Lorie Logan)——转而呼吁加息 25 个基点。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
